bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 170, Number 74 (Tuesday, April 30, 2024)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. GOLDEN of Maine:
H.R. 8173.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
This bill is enacted pursuant to the power granted to
Congress under Article I, Section 8, Clause 18 of the United
States Constitution.
The single subject of this legislation is:
To prohibit former Members of Congress from engaging in
lobbying contacts.
[Page H2770]

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on the Judiciary.

bill.title: To amend title 18, United States Code, to prohibit former Members of Congress from engaging in lobbying contacts.
